This semantic mismatch suggests a deeper generative inconsistency than just local texture blur. The 'structural_collapse' of the cable (fading into clouds) is a valid artifact, but the lack of a clear mounting bracket is a more critical structural defect that the Router noted but did not flag as an artifact.
